title: Apply for an industry participant and promoter registration
summary: Apply online to register as an industry participant and promoter to carry out combat sport activities in NSW.
intro:
The Combat Sports Authority of NSW grants registration in accordance with the Combat Sports Act 2013.

You can apply online to register as an industry participant and promoter to carry out activities at combat sport contests in NSW. The roles an industry participant and promoter may apply to be registered for include:

Registration expires 3 years from the date granted, unless cancelled earlier, or the term is extended or reduced.
who_can_apply: Must be aged 18 or over if applying for promoter, manager, or matchmaker registration classes.
Must not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.
what_you_need: A recent passport size photograph in JPG/PNG format (maximum file size 10MB).
Proof of identity (e.g., Australian driver licence, Australian passport, Australian birth certificate, etc.).
Successful completion of training relating to the management of concussions and head injuries.
Specific documentation required based on the role applied for (e.g., Trainer, Referee, Judge, Timekeeper, Promoter, Manager, or Matchmaker).

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for your combat sports industry participant and promoter registration.

more_info.text: Emails are used to communicate with you throughout the application process. To ensure you don't miss out on important information you should:

If your application is incomplete, or you fail to provide the required information, your application will be delayed and may be refused. If your application is refused there is no provision for a refund of your registration application fee.
You'll get an industry participant identity card which will be mailed to your postal address within 10 business days.

Applications for promoter, manager and matchmaker are referred to the Commissioner of Police for a security determination. This may take several weeks. Promoters must allow sufficient time for their application to be considered. It is an offence to arrange a combat sport contest unless registered in the appropriate promoter class.

faqs.q: How long is the registration valid for?
faqs.a: The registration expires 3 years from the date it is granted, unless it is cancelled earlier, or the term is extended or reduced.

faqs.q: Who must apply for promoter, manager, or matchmaker registration?
faqs.a: Applicants for promoter, manager, or matchmaker registration classes must be aged 18 or over, and must not be a controlled member of a declared organisation under the Crimes (Criminal Organisations Control) Act 2012.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, a recent passport size photograph (JPG/PNG, max 10MB), your personal details, proof of identity, successful completion of training relating to the management of concussions and head injuries, your payment, and specific documentation depending on your role (e.g., Trainer, Referee, Judge, Timekeeper, Promoter, Manager, or Matchmaker).
